mapper.sql: id, equipment_no, name, equipment_type, location, brand, status, buy_date, maintain_cycle, last_maintain, next_maintain, keeper, remark

where.if: AND (equipment_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR keeper LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment (equipment_no, name, equipment_type, location, brand, status, buy_date, maintain_cycle, last_maintain, next_maintain, keeper, remark) VALUES (#{equipmentNo}, #{name}, IFNULL(#{equipmentType}, 'OTHER'), #{location}, #{brand}, IFNULL(#{status}, 'NORMAL'), #{buyDate}, IFNULL(#{maintainCycle}, 30), #{lastMaintain}, #{nextMaintain}, #{keeper}, #{remark})
